CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sonoQuizzes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `createdByUserId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(300) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `timeLimitSeconds` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 20,
  `musicTrack` varchar(100),
  `theme` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'teal',
  `coverImageUrl` text,
  `category` enum('Abdominal','Small Parts','Pelvic/Gyn','OB 1st Trimester','OB 2nd/3rd Trimester','Fetal Echo','Breast','Vascular','MSK','POCUS','Physics','General') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'General',
  `questionCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `status` enum('draft','published','archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sonoQuizQuestions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `quizId` int NOT NULL,
  `question` longtext NOT NULL,
  `options` text NOT NULL,
  `correctAnswer` int NOT NULL,
  `explanation` longtext,
  `mediaUrl` text,
  `mediaType` enum('image','video','gif'),
  `timeLimitSeconds` int,
  `points` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  `sortOrder` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizQuestions_quizId` (`quizId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sonoQuizSessions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `quizId` int NOT NULL,
  `hostUserId` int NOT NULL,
  `joinCode` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('lobby','active','paused','ended') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lobby',
  `currentQuestionIndex` int,
  `questionStartedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `allowAnonymous` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `showLeaderboard` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `quizSnapshot` longtext,
  `participantCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `startedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `endedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_sonoQuizSessions_joinCode` (`joinCode`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizSessions_quizId` (`quizId`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizSessions_hostUserId` (`hostUserId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sonoQuizParticipants` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sessionId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int,
  `displayName` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `avatarSeed` varchar(50),
  `totalScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `finalRank` int,
  `isActive` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `joinedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizParticipants_sessionId` (`sessionId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sonoQuizAnswers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sessionId` int NOT NULL,
  `participantId` int NOT NULL,
  `questionId` int NOT NULL,
  `selectedAnswer` int NOT NULL DEFAULT -1,
  `isCorrect` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `pointsEarned` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `responseTimeMs` int,
  `answeredAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizAnswers_sessionId` (`sessionId`),
  KEY `idx_sonoQuizAnswers_participantId` (`participantId`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_sonoQuizAnswers_participant_question` (`participantId`, `questionId`)
);
